executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 2 errors related to incorrect method signatures and enum overriding. TaskController calls getUserTasks with wrong parameters (int, int instead of Pageable), and TaskStatus enum incorrectly overrides the final name() method from java.lang.Enum. Fix the method call to use PageRequest.of() and remove the name() override from TaskStatus enum.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int
errors.root_cause: TaskController.getUserTasks() is calling taskService.getUserTasks(userId, page, size) with two int parameters, but the service method signature expects (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The controller is not creating a Pageable object.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace taskService.getUserTasks(userId, page, size) with taskService.getUserTasks(userId, PageRequest.of(page, size)). Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest at the top of the file.

errors.message: name() in TaskStatus cannot override name() in java.lang.Enum; overridden method is final
errors.root_cause: TaskStatus enum is attempting to override the name() method from java.lang.Enum, but name() is declared as final in the Enum class and cannot be overridden. This is a fundamental Java language constraint.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the name() method override from TaskStatus enum. If you need a custom display name, create a new method like getDisplayName() or use a field with a getter instead of overriding name().
